class Finder { found: string | null = null; run(items: string[]) { this.found = null; items.forEach((i) => { if (i === "b") this.found = i; }); return this.found!.length; } }
const state: { best: number | null } = { best: null };
state.best = null;
[1, 2].forEach((v) => { if (state.best === null || v > state.best) state.best = v; });
console.log(state.best!.toFixed(), new Finder().run(["a", "b"]));
const o: { s: string | null } = { s: null };
o.s = null;
const t: 1 = o.s!;
const m: { [k: string]: number | null } = {};
m["k"] = null;
console.log(m["k"]!.toFixed);
